chart.name: Sending queue length (hourly trend)
chart.programText:
legacy_queue = data('otelcol_processor_queued_retry_queue_length', rollup='average').mean(cycle='hour', cycle_start='0m', partial_values=False)
exporter_queue = data('otelcol_exporter_queue_size', rollup='average').mean(cycle='hour', cycle_start='0m', partial_values=False)
union(legacy_queue, exporter_queue).publish("A")
